extracted.intended_audience: legal researchers, compliance officers, regulated entities, and members of the public seeking to read or implement CFPB regulations
extracted.subtask_description: Using the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's interactive regulations resource to read, navigate, and understand Bureau regulations in Title XII of the CFR, and to find implementation/guidance materials or submit inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official-source disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: This resource is not an official legal edition of the Code of Federal Regulations or the Federal Register, and it does not replace the official versions of those publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are relying on it for legal research, please consult the official editions of those sources to confirm your findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy caveat
rubrics_metrics.description: The Bureau has made every effort to ensure the material presented in this resource is accurate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Despite efforts to ensure accuracy, users should verify critical legal points against the official CFR or Federal Register; the resource is intended to be easier-to-navigate, not authoritative for legal citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use implementation and guidance materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Visit our implementation and guidance page to view a variety of materials to help you understand and implement this rule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before relying on or attempting to implement a rule (or before submitting inquiries), review the Bureau's implementation materials, guidance, regulations, and official interpretation available on the website.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review guidance before inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Please review the implementation and guidance materials available on our website, including regulations and official interpretation, before submitting a question about the Bureau’s rules or regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is procedural guidance to reduce unnecessary inquiries and ensure questioners have consulted available explanatory and implementation resources first.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check page version and modification date
rubrics_metrics.description: Page last modified May 26, 2022. View older versions of this page at our public archive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should check the last modified date and archived versions to confirm the currentness of the regulation text and to see historical changes.
